fact: CAJ News reported on 20 February 2025 that Namibia had officially launched its National AI Strategy, founded on a National AI Council with sector Technical Working Groups; later official statements (August 2025 and 2026) say no strategy yet exists, so this report conflicts with them.
title: Namibia launches national AI strategy
why_not: Contradicted by the minister's statement of August 2025 and 2026 sources that the strategy is still being written.
